visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen montage featuring the main character eating noodles and shots of an old Bangkok street. The creator is a male with short dark hair, wearing a navy blue 'GAP' hoodie. (2) He explores a vintage shop interior packed with ornate gold-framed paintings, ceramic bowls, and antique glassware under warm indoor lighting. (3) Close-ups show minimalist perfume bottles on a grey shelf and a collage wall covered in colorful art posters and stickers. (4) The creator and three friends pose together in front of a street sign labeled 'I WANNA BANGKOK' against a backdrop of weathered urban walls with graffiti. (5) A tracking shot moves through narrow alleys, showing large food-themed murals and a view of the Chao Phraya River with city skyscrapers. (6) At 'PICKING MANGO', a staff member uses a pole to lower a drink bag from a high window to the customer below. (7) The creator sits in a brightly lit restaurant using red chopsticks to eat beef noodles; the scene includes detailed shots of the broth, thin noodles, and tender beef slices. (8) A view of the open kitchen shows a large partitioned simmering pot of soup. (9) The video concludes with the restaurant exterior and a shot of a nearby shop where people are packing steamed buns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic pop music with a prominent 4/4 beat starts instantly. A high-energy male narrator welcomes the audience with a friendly, projected tone. (2) As the scene transitions to the vintage shop, the music continues while the narrator speaks quickly, describing the 'artsy' vibe. (3) A loud slurping SFX is heard as the creator takes a big bite of noodles, followed by a slight metallic click of chopsticks hitting the bowl. (4) The audio energy dips slightly for a second (strategic silence) before the narrator excitedly recommends the beef noodle soup. (5) In the final phase, background chatter from the market is audible under the BGM and narration. The music fades out alongside the narrator's closing invitation.
